title: [RPG Review] The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel

blocks.source: 【RPGレビュー】英雄伝説 閃の軌跡
blocks.translation: [RPG Review] The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Substance / Story

blocks.source: 学園モノとなった軌跡シリーズ。ＰＳ３版とＰＳＶｉｔａ版が存在するが、ＰＳ３版でプレイしている。
blocks.translation: The Trails series has become a school-based RPG. There are PS3 and PS Vita versions, but I played the PS3 version.

blocks.source: サブイベントをほとんどこなした上で、クリアまで約７０時間。
blocks.translation: It took about 70 hours to clear, having completed almost all the sub-events.

blocks.source: 主人公リィンと仲間達は学園生活を送ったり、実習で遠出したりしながら様々な問題を解決していく。
blocks.translation: Protagonist Rean and his friends solve various problems while attending school and traveling to distant places for practical training.

blocks.source: 基本的にはストーリー重視のキャラゲー。ゲーム進行の仕組みなどを含めて、ペルソナ３以降に感覚が近い。
blocks.translation: Basically, it is a character-driven game that prioritizes its story. Including the way the game progresses, it feels similar to Persona 3 and later titles.

blocks.source: 限られた行動機会でキャラクター達と絆を深めていくことができる。……凄くペルソナっぽいです。
blocks.translation: You can deepen your bonds with the characters through limited opportunities to act. ……It feels very much like Persona.

blocks.source: イベント進行の合間に仲間と会話できるようになっており、仲間とその関連人物を追っているだけで何となく楽しい。
blocks.translation: You can talk with your friends between events, and simply following the characters and the people connected to them is somehow enjoyable.

blocks.source: 舞台は学園なので、サブクエストで関わるモブキャラにも部活などの特徴ができた。クエストの内容もその分、印象に残りやすくなっている。
blocks.translation: Since the setting is a school, even the minor characters involved in side quests have distinctive traits, such as belonging to clubs. This also makes the quests more memorable.

blocks.source: モブキャラの数は減ったが、それでも十分多い。むしろ、前が多すぎた気がするので個人的にはちょうど良かった。
blocks.translation: There are fewer minor characters, but there are still plenty. In fact, I felt there had been too many before, so this was just right for me.

blocks.source: 終盤の展開は、ミステリー的などんでん返しもあって驚き。こういうのは個人的に好み。
blocks.translation: The developments toward the end are surprising, with some mystery-like twists. I personally enjoy this kind of thing.

blocks.source: そして、過去の軌跡シリーズもそうだったけれど、話はきっちりと終わらず続編に続く。零の軌跡程度には区切りをつけて欲しかったけれど、そうはいかず。
blocks.translation: Also, as with the previous Trails games, the story does not end properly and continues into the sequel. I would have liked it to reach a stopping point comparable to Trails from Zero, but that was not the case.

blocks.source: 自分は知った上でやったから気にならなかったけど、知らずに半端なエンドを見た人は腹を立てるかも。
blocks.translation: I knew that going in, so it did not bother me, but people who see the incomplete ending without knowing might get angry.

blocks.source: 過去シリーズからの既存キャラは比較的少ないので、この作品からシリーズに入るのもよさそう。ただし、零＆碧の軌跡と時系列が同じで関連もある。やっぱり既プレイに越したことはなし。
blocks.translation: There are relatively few returning characters from earlier games, so this seems like a good entry point to the series. However, it takes place during the same period as Trails from Zero and Trails to Azure and is related to them. Still, having played those games beforehand is preferable.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: ＰＳＶｉｔａの初期バージョンはそれはもうロードの長さが酷かったらしい。
blocks.translation: Apparently, the load times in the initial PS Vita version were truly terrible.

blocks.source: ＰＳ３のver1.03でプレイしたが、さほどの不快感はなく、一応は快適といえるレベル。戦闘開始まで７秒。マップの切り替えに３～５秒程度なので、そんなに気にならないはず。
blocks.translation: I played the PS3 version with ver1.03, and it was not particularly uncomfortable—just about comfortable enough. It takes seven seconds to start a battle. Map transitions take around 3–5 seconds, so they should not be too bothersome.

blocks.source: 移動速度は速め。Ｒボタン押しっぱなしでダッシュできるがかなり速い。マップから主要な地点まで移動できることもあって、移動のストレスはかなり抑えられている。
blocks.translation: The movement speed is fairly fast. You can dash by holding down the R button, and it is quite fast. Since you can also travel from the map to major locations, the stress of getting around is significantly reduced.

blocks.source: おなじみのクエストは面倒なものがやや減った。
blocks.translation: There are slightly fewer of the familiar tedious quests.

blocks.source: 少なくとも「魔獣を倒しまくれ！」とか「クリアしたダンジョンの奥までもう一度行け！」みたいなものは減ったように思う。
blocks.translation: At least, there seem to be fewer quests like “Go defeat a ton of monsters!” or “Go back to the depths of a dungeon you already cleared!”

blocks.source: ３章のノルド高原だけちょっと面倒かも。広めのマップを馬に乗って、行ったり来たりさせられる。といっても片道数分～５分程度だけど。
blocks.translation: Only the Nord Highlands in Chapter 3 might be a little tedious. You ride a horse back and forth across a fairly large map. That said, it only takes a few minutes to five minutes each way.

blocks.source: 戦闘に関しては、とにかく味方が恩恵を受けられる要素が多い。装備や技が整う中盤以降は、ザコ戦で敵を一方的にボコれる。強力な広範囲技がたくさんあるので、どの敵を先に倒すかといった戦術もあまり考える必要もなし。そんな具合なので結果的に敵の印象は薄くなりやすい。
blocks.translation: As far as battles go, there are simply many elements that benefit your party. From the middle of the game onward, once your equipment and skills are in order, you can beat up weaker enemies one-sidedly. There are many powerful wide-area skills, so you do not need to think much about tactics such as which enemy to defeat first. As a result, the enemies tend to leave little impression.

blocks.source: ただし、ヌルゲーと思って油断すると落とし穴がある。どうも味方のインフレに対抗するためか、敵の攻撃もインフレ気味。２～３発攻撃を喰らっただけで戦闘不能に陥ることも。
blocks.translation: However, there is a pitfall if you let your guard down, thinking it is an easy game. Perhaps to counteract the power inflation on your side, enemy attacks also seem somewhat inflated. You can become incapacitated after taking only two or three hits.

blocks.source: 後半のボスは一撃でこちらを全滅寸前に追い込むことがあるので、油断すると一気に苦戦する。
blocks.translation: Bosses in the latter half can sometimes bring your entire party to the brink of defeat with a single attack, so letting your guard down can suddenly make the battle difficult.

blocks.source: ３Ｄになったけれど、戦闘テンポ上の問題はないはず。技を使ってもキビキビ動く。攻撃の強さもあって、過去のシリーズ作品より改善された印象を受けた。
blocks.translation: Although it has become 3D, there should be no issues with the battle tempo. Characters move briskly even when using skills. Combined with the strength of the attacks, it felt like an improvement over the previous games in the series.

blocks.source: 戦闘アニメはカット可能。カットしても１秒程度の暗転が入るので、短い技だとあんまり意味なかったり。
blocks.translation: Battle animations can be skipped. Even when skipped, there is about one second of a black screen, so it is not always worthwhile for short skills.

blocks.source: パーティメンバーはたくさんいるが、ストーリーの都合である程度までしか自由が効かない。キャラが多いので、こうでもしないと使う機会がないという考え方も。
blocks.translation: There are many party members, but due to the demands of the story, you only have limited freedom in choosing them. Since there are so many characters, one could also argue that this is necessary to ensure they all get opportunities to be used.

blocks.source: シリーズ当初からのシンボルエンカウント形式。
blocks.translation: It uses the symbol encounter system that the series has had since the beginning.

blocks.source: 狭い道が多いので、敵を避けるのが難しいこともあるが、そこまで敵が多いわけではないので、さほどのストレスにはならないはず。
blocks.translation: There are many narrow paths, so avoiding enemies can sometimes be difficult, but there are not so many enemies that it should become particularly stressful.

blocks.source: 魔法習得のルールがグッとシンプルに。過去作では複雑さゆえに返って選択肢が狭まるところがあったので、個人的にはこれでよかったと思う。
blocks.translation: The rules for learning magic have become much simpler. In previous games, the complexity sometimes narrowed your choices instead, so I personally think this was a good change.

blocks.source: 毎度ながら、期間限定要素を取り逃がさなかったことに報酬を与えるようなゲーム。コンプを目指すとストレスになることもあるので、どこまでやり込むかは考えておかないといけない。
blocks.translation: As always, this is the kind of game that rewards you for not missing time-limited content. Aiming for completion can be stressful, so you need to decide how thoroughly you want to play.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: ＰＳ３にしては大したことない部類とは思うけれど、個人的にはこれだけあれば十分。戦闘はキビキビ動くし、技や魔法も派手。
blocks.translation: I think it is fairly unimpressive for a PS3 game, but personally, this is more than enough. Battles move briskly, and the skills and magic are flashy.

blocks.source: キャラクターは表情なども表現されている。過去作のちびキャラを思えば、よくここまでやったなあと感心。
blocks.translation: The characters even have facial expressions and other details represented. Considering the chibi characters in the previous games, I was impressed by how far they had come.

blocks.source: 背景のグラフィックな大幅に向上。世界設定が丁寧に練り込まれている作品なので、国や町毎の特色も表現されている。
blocks.translation: The background graphics have improved significantly. Since this is a work with a carefully developed world setting, the distinctive features of each country and town are also conveyed.

blocks.source: 広大なノルド高原を馬で駆け抜けるのも気持ちが良い。
blocks.translation: It is also exhilarating to gallop through the vast Nord Highlands on horseback.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 安心のファルコム音楽。フィールド曲から戦闘曲まで安定している。
blocks.translation: Falcom music you can count on. It is consistently good, from the field tracks to the battle music.

blocks.source: オープニングのミッションで流れる曲やノルド高原で流れる曲がお気に入り。
blocks.translation: I particularly like the song played during the opening mission and the song played in the Nord Highlands.

blocks.source: 総評
blocks.translation: Overall Assessment

blocks.source: 発売当初はロード時間の長さなどで不評を浴びた作品。ただアップデートで改善されてからプレイしたため、問題は感じなかった。
blocks.translation: This title was poorly received at launch due to its long loading times and other issues. However, I played it after an update had improved things, so I didn't notice any problems.

blocks.source: 良くも悪くもストーリー偏重なので、「ダンジョンや戦闘が一時間以上ない」なんて状況は当たり前。戦闘周りの出来も決して悪くないけれど、基本はストーリーやキャラクターを楽しむゲーム。そこが楽しめない人にはハズレだと思う。
blocks.translation: It's very story-focused, for better or worse, so situations like “going more than an hour without a dungeon or battle” are commonplace. The battle system isn't bad by any means, but this is fundamentally a game to enjoy for its story and characters. I think it's a miss for anyone who can't enjoy those aspects.

blocks.source: 過去作のファンからはやや不評な印象があったのだけど、戦闘もストーリーも個人的にはこのシリーズでは一番楽しめた。
blocks.translation: I had the impression that fans of the previous games viewed it somewhat negatively, but personally, I enjoyed both the battles and the story more than in any other game in this series.

blocks.source: 半端なところで終わるストーリーだけが問題で、続編の２になってもキリがつかないという……。
blocks.translation: The only problem is that the story ends at an awkward point, and even the sequel, number 2, doesn't bring it to a proper conclusion...
